summary: Implemented the standalone endpoint-resolver builtins feature in the botocore repo. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `from enum import Enum` and appended the str-valued EndpointResolverBuiltins enum with the eleven members from the spec table, each commented with its meaning and type. (2) botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint; made the STS predicate accept an absent endpoint config (treated as no variant tags); added ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults at the end of the class, returning a dict keyed by the enum members. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (derives from unittest.TestCase) with tests covering every behavioral criterion, including one custom-data legacy-URL test and one bundled-data absent-SDK-endpoint test. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py 59 passed; test_client.py, test_utils.py, test_regions.py 635 passed total. Choices: SDK::Endpoint key is always present, with None when absent; FIPS and DualStack use the bridge's existing private lookup methods. Not verified: black and isort were not run, since they were not available in the prepared venv and I did not install anything; line lengths were checked manually (no added line exceeds 79 columns). Nothing was committed.
